name: Minh Thi Phan
title: The Secretary
ability:
[reaction] After an investigator at your location commits a card to a skill test: That card gains a [wild] icon until the end of the test. (Limit once for each investigator per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may choose a skill card committed to this skill test to return to its owner's hand after this test ends.
ability_cn:
[reaction]你所在地点的调查员在技能检定中投入一张卡牌后：在此次技能检定结束前，该卡牌获得1个[wild]图标。(每位调查员每轮限制1次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。本次技能检定结束后，你可以选择投入本次技能检定的一张技能卡返回其所有者的手牌。
elder_sign: [elder_sign] effect: +1. You may choose a skill card committed to this skill test to return to its owner's hand after this test ends.
elder_sign_cn: [elder_sign]效果：+1。本次技能检定结束后，你可以选择投入本次技能检定的一张技能卡返回其所有者的手牌。
flavor_text: "You can depend on me to guide you through the unknown."
back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Analytical Mind, The King in Yellow (Act 1), 1 random basic weakness.
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：探求者卡([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，求生者卡([survivor])等级0-2。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：缜密分析、黄衣之王(第一幕)、1张随机基础弱点。
